Make the register part of every purchase above a set value and set up a confidential reporting email and phone line.

Set quarterly committee dates for the year and complete the workshop risk assessment.
Move all licence dates into the compliance calendar with 60-day reminders to two people.

Check the 3 products, stop using any that are unregistered, and make the number a required field.
Start the regulatory change log and report it to the Finance and Audit sub-committee each quarter.
